name: Citron-crested Cockatoo
rangeDescription: Sumba (lesser sundas)
description: A medium-sized white cockatoo with an orange crest; endemic to the island of Sumba, where it is highly threatened by trapping and habitat loss. Raucous and social, usually seen in large flocks flying noisily over forested areas.

name: Bare-eyed Myna
rangeDescription: Sula islands (taliabu and mangole)
description: A very distinctive black-and-white myna. Long-tailed and magpie-like, with white underparts, crown, and back.

name: Papyrus Gonolek
rangeDescription: Papyrus swamps of democratic republic of the congo to uganda, kenya, and tanzania
description: Boldly patterned black-and-red bushshrike with a yellow crown and pale eyes. The duller immature has orange underparts and a gray crown.

name: Green-headed Tanager
rangeDescription: Southeastern paraguay to southeastern brazil and northeastern argentina (misiones)
description: Strikingly beautiful multicolored tanager found in the canopy of humid forests, at forest borders, and in second growth, urban parks, and gardens. The head, nape, chin, and breast are a bright aquamarine-green with a lime green neck patch, wings, belly and an orange rump.

name: Red-bellied Myzomela
rangeDescription: Malaita (central solomon islands)
description: A bulky, striking myzomela, mostly pitch black with a bright red rump and a bright crimson chest, throat, and flanks forming a “vest.” Belly, back, and head deep black. Female chocolate-brown above and ruddy-brown below.

name: St. Lucia Thrasher
rangeDescription: Dry forest of lowlands of st. lucia (lesser antilles)
description: A ground-feeding denizen found locally in wooded ravines and valleys with thick low vegetation. It somewhat resembles both Brown and Gray Tremblers in shape but it has bold white underparts and a dark red eye, which the tremblers lack.

name: Wedge-tailed Jery
rangeDescription: Rainforest of eastern madagascar (sianaka forest southward to vondrozo)
description: Small, dark understory tetraka. Has yellowish underparts and a gray ear patch.

name: Hainan Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Hainan (southern china)
description: Beautifully luminous small leaf warbler restricted to the forests of China’s Hainan Island. Bright yellow all over, though darker wings and crown make paler wingbars and eyebrow visible nonetheless.

name: Dusky Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Mountains of central mexico (michoacán to oaxaca)
description: Rather drab, “female-plumaged,” medium-size hummingbird of arid scrubby habitats, including gardens and open woodlands. Feeds at all levels and usually wags and fans tail persistently while hovering—a good field character.

name: Philippine Magpie-Robin
rangeDescription: Philippines (except palawan)
description: A common medium-sized bird of open forest, scrub, and gardens from the lowlands to middle elevations in the mountains. Male has black upperparts, throat, and chest, a white belly, and a prominent white mark in the wing.

name: Snowy-crowned Tern
rangeDescription: Lagoons and marshes of southeastern brazil and uruguay to patagonia
description: Attractive but often rather local tern of southern South America. Favors shallow coastal waters, but also ranges inland locally along rivers and lakes.

name: Blue-winged Racquet-tail
rangeDescription: Sulu archipelago
description: A rare medium-sized parrot of lowland forest and edge on the Sulu Islands, possibly only remaining on Tawi-Tawi. The two central tail feathers have extended shafts ending in a racket shape.

name: Dusky Starfrontlet
rangeDescription: Western andes of colombia (antioquia)
description: Rare hummingbird known only from a few locations in the northern half of Colombia’s western Andes. Large and long billed with iridescent green belly and rump.

name: Townsend's Shearwater
rangeDescription: Breeds revillagigedo islands (off western mexico); disperses to 8°n
description: Endangered, small black-and-white shearwater, endemic to Mexico. Found around Socorro Island mainly from November to May, and rarely offshore between Jalisco and Oaxaca.

name: Wilson's Indigobird
rangeDescription: Senegambia to guinea, eastward to northeastern democratic republic of the congo, south sudan, and western ethiopia
description: A nest parasite that lays its eggs in the nests of Bar-breasted Firefinch. Breeding males are glossy purplish-black with a pale brownish panel in the wings, while females and non-breeding males are brown and streaky on the back and pale below, with a bold facial pattern.

name: Mindoro Bulbul
rangeDescription: Philippines (mindoro and semirara)
description: A medium-sized bird of lowland and montane forest and more open wooded areas on Mindoro and Semirara. Dark brown on the upperparts and chest with a pale belly, a fairly long stout black bill, and a grayish head with faint streaks.

name: Dugand's Antwren
rangeDescription: Locally in far southeastern colombia, eastern ecuador, and northeastern peru
description: Handsome antwren found in the canopy of lowland rainforest in eastern Ecuador, northeastern Peru, and southern Colombia. Male is gray with black crown, eye-stripe, and upper tail; wings are black with white bars and tail has white edges.

name: White-lined Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Northern australia (sandstones of western arnhem land, northern territory)
description: Rather plain medium-sized honeyeater found in sandstone escarpment and gorge country of western Arnhem Land, including the sandstone areas of Kakadu National Park and Katherine Gorge. Upperparts uniformly gray-green, underparts pale with diffuse gray streaks on chest.

name: Mandarin Duck
rangeDescription: Wooded ponds, swamps, and streams of northeastern asia from southeastern siberia, korean peninsula, japan, and eastern china
description: Small exotic-looking duck found at lakes and parks, usually with nearby trees. Male very ornate with big orangey

name: Abyssinian Roller
rangeDescription: Senegambia to ethiopia, somalia, and kenya; central arabia
description: A slim and beautiful roller with very long outer tail feathers. In flight, the spectacular wings are half pale blue and half dark blue.
